result:
The api died because the data disk filled up: a `report-export` job wrote about 20 GB to `/var/lib/stockroom` in eight minutes, Postgres ran out of space, and the api exited at 03:14:06 and never came back.

One thing to check first: the log covers 2026-03-09 02:00–05:30, not last night (today is 2026-10-08). If there was an outage last night, this file doesn't contain it.

Timeline from the log:

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 03:05:00 | `report-export` starts writing 512 MB CSV parts to `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/`, one every 12 seconds |
| 03:09:03 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 91%` |
| 03:12:48 | Last of 40 export parts written (about 20 GB total) |
| 03:13:30 | `WARN disk /var/lib/stockroom at 99%` |
| 03:14:00 | `ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device` |
| 03:14:03 | `ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool` |
| 03:14:06 | `FATAL api: exiting (status 1)` |
| 03:16:00 onward | `ERROR proxy: upstream api refused connection` every 2 minutes, through the end of the log |

- **No recovery in this log:** there are zero api requests after 03:14:06, and the proxy is still reporting refused connections at 05:28. Web and proxy kept serving 200s throughout.
- **No restart logged:** the api has `restart: unless-stopped` in `docker-compose.yml`, but the log shows no restart attempt. Either it wasn't restarting or it kept failing without logging here; I can't tell which from this file.
- **Unrelated noise:** the 43 `cache: slow command` warnings (100–149 ms) run evenly through the whole log, before and after the crash.

The export job shares a volume with the database, and the 91% warning five minutes before the crash did not stop it. No `report-export` job exists in this repo, so I couldn't check what triggered it or why it wrote so much.

Nothing was changed. Separately, the ponytail plugin's statusline badge isn't configured; say so if you want me to add it to `settings.json`.
